item.title: Demonstrators interrupt Israeli minister Ben-Gvir at university
item.description: Far-right Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir was forced to leave a stage in Tel Aviv after demonstrators interrupted his appearance.

item.title: মুসলমানদের পরিচিত বাক্য বিসমিল্লাহ ও তার শিক্ষা
item.description: বিসমিল্লাহ মুসলমানদের একটি অত্যন্ত পরিচিত বাক্য। এই বাক্য উচ্চারণের সময় প্রত্যেকের লক্ষ্য রাখা উচিত যেন সংশ্লিষ্ট কাজটি এর আদর্শের বিপরীত না হয়।

item.title: Brighton's 5-0 win over Crystal Palace sparks title discussion
item.description: Following Brighton's decisive 5-0 win against Crystal Palace, football analysts Shay Given and Dion Dublin discussed the team's potential in the championship race.

item.title: Jacqui Lambie denounces One Nation cartoon mocking her health
item.description: Independent senator Jacqui Lambie condemned a One Nation animated video that ridiculed her medical condition. Fellow crossbencher Monique Ryan expressed support for her.

item.title: UK steel sector lags EU rivals due to rising electricity prices
item.description: British steel producers face a widening disadvantage against European competitors as electricity expenses surged following a conflict involving the US, Israel, and Iran.

item.title: Venezuelan opposition backs Maria Corina Machado as leader
item.description: The political opposition in Venezuela reaffirmed its backing for Maria Corina Machado. The exiled figure has called for fresh elections and permission to return home.

item.title: Chief Justice delays bail hearing citing threats to safety
item.description: A bail hearing involving Ranka and Das was postponed by a judge who reported facing pressure and threats to personal safety.

item.title: Sydney resident arrested following reported gunfire and lockdown
item.description: A man in Sydney was taken into custody after police investigated reports of a stolen vehicle and a firearm incident that led to a local lockdown in Dulwich Hill.

item.title: Xbox Series X plays PS5 titles due to similar hardware design
item.description: Due to shared hardware architectures, the Xbox Series X can now execute PlayStation 5 software, though specific limitations apply. This crossover capability stems from the structural similarities between both gaming platforms.

item.title: MP Srinivas Poojary urges better state aid delivery for farmers
item.description: Parliamentarian Srinivas Poojary stated that governmental welfare programs must reach agriculturists more efficiently. He noted that multiple cropping and horticulture have successfully uplifted numerous rural residents.

item.title: Konkan Railway shifts to non-monsoon schedule on October 21
item.description: The Konkan Railway will transition to its standard timetable, ending the seasonal monsoon schedule introduced on June 15. The rainy season protocol had enforced slower train speeds to prevent weather-related incidents.

item.title: Trump delays Russian sanctions to sustain peace talks
item.description: United States President Trump halted several impending penalties against Russia just two days prior to their activation. He explained that this decision aims to maintain ongoing peace discussions.

item.title: Bomb threat forces emergency landing on Tel Aviv to Vienna flight
item.description: An aircraft traveling from Tel Aviv to Vienna was compelled to make an unscheduled emergency landing following a bomb threat. Authorities responded to the security concern mid-journey.

item.title: Highways Secretary inspects road widening, ROB works in Vellore
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, Highways officials stated that the team assessed quality of raw materials used for the work. Key points: Highways Secretary, Vellore Highways, highways, secretary.

item.title: Street Fighter leads North American box office with $51 million
item.description: Paramount's Street Fighter dominated North American box office earnings over the weekend. The feature film brought in $31 million domestically as part of a broader $51 million total haul amid multiple new releases.

item.title: Starlink has two $55 plans that are wildly different
item.description: As reported by Engadget, It's a trade. Key points: Starlink, starlink, plans, wildly.

item.title: Savannah Officer Dismissed For Sharing License Plate Reader Access
item.description: Amber Harpe lost her job at the Savannah police department in August after an internal probe revealed she gave her Flock system credentials to her spouse, Tyler Harpe, an ICE employee. The agency clarified it does not permit Immigration and Customs Enforcement to access its Flock database.

item.title: Former North Carolina School Reopens As Senior Housing Facility
item.description: The vacant Dillard School in North Carolina has been converted into the Dillard School Senior Apartments after sitting empty for two decades. Cassandra Henderson, an alumnus of the institution, is among the older residents who have moved back into the historic building.

item.title: Blaze at Canadian Military Facility Leaves Four Dead
item.description: A fire at a Canadian military base resulted in four fatalities and left 19 individuals in critical condition. Authorities are investigating the incident at the military installation.

item.title: John Legend Donates Half a Million to Ohio Theater Restoration
item.description: Musician John Legend contributed $500,000 to renovate an old school auditorium in his hometown of Springfield, Ohio. The newly named John Legend Theater now accommodates community gatherings and youth musical performances.

item.title: Macron Warns French Rioters As Arrests Reach 2,400
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron stated that individuals responsible for destruction must face consequences following widespread unrest. Law enforcement officials have detained 2,400 people amid the ongoing protests.

item.title: সনাতন ধর্মাবলম্বীদের বড় উৎসব দুর্গাপূজা উদযাপিত
item.description: দেশজুড়ে সনাতন ধর্মাবলম্বীদের প্রধান ধর্মীয় উৎসব শারদীয় দুর্গোৎসব পালিত হচ্ছে। মণ্ডপগুলোতে চলছে দেবীর আরাধনা, অঞ্জলি এবং সন্ধ্যা আরতি। এই উৎসবকে ঘিরে চারদিকে আনন্দ ও সম্প্রীতির পরিবেশ বিরাজ করছে।

item.title: Comparing Home Network Hardware: Gateways Versus Separate Devices
item.description: While gateway devices combine modem and router functions into a single unit, using separate hardware components offers increased flexibility and performance. Homeowners can choose between these setups depending on their specific networking requirements.

item.title: Future of Alberta's Separatist Movement Following Expected Vote Defeat
item.description: Alberta's secessionist campaign is anticipated to fail at the ballot box. However, past political precedents indicate that a referendum loss may not completely halt the regional independence push.

item.title: Chennai Mayor Blames State Authorities for Slow Monsoon Prep
item.description: The Chennai Mayor claimed that the government delayed seasonal preparations by failing to meet during July or August. She additionally criticized the low financial support given to urban infrastructure upkeep.

item.title: Fatal Blaze at Canadian Military Installation Kills Four
item.description: A massive fire at a military facility in Canada has resulted in at least four confirmed fatalities. Authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the deadly incident at the base.

item.title: Ladakh Chief Secretary Discusses Regional Demands
item.description: The Ladakh Chief Secretary stated the central government remains dedicated to addressing regional needs. Local civil society groups previously rejected a Home Ministry proposal for a directly elected territorial body.

item.title: Bulgarian Jet Escorts Tel Aviv Flight Following Bomb Threat
item.description: A commercial flight originating from Tel Aviv was forced to reroute to Bulgaria due to a bomb scare. The country's transport department stated that a MiG-29 fighter aircraft was deployed to guide the plane.

item.title: Haryana Political Clash: Chief Minister and Congress Exchange Barbs
item.description: Haryana CM Saini touted regional prosperity while criticizing past governance. Meanwhile, Congress accused the administration of increasing debt and crime.

item.title: Rescue Operations Underway After Vessel Overturns Near Baja California
item.description: U.S. and Mexican forces are actively searching for individuals missing after a boat capsized. Sixteen survivors have already been rescued from the water.

item.title: Mbappe Nets Twice in Real Madrid Victory Over Sevilla
item.description: Real Madrid defeated Sevilla 4-1 in a La Liga match featuring two goals from Kylian Mbappe. The win narrows their deficit behind Barcelona to six points before their upcoming El Clasico match.

item.title: Updates Introduced to Apple Image Playground Application
item.description: Apple's artificial intelligence image creation software received significant enhancements during the autumn season. The tool provides various features for generating visuals.

item.title: Minister Rekha Arya's Spouse Alleges Corrupt Wealth Accumulation
item.description: Uttarakhand Minister Rekha Arya was accused by her husband, Girdhari Lal Sahu, of acquiring illegal wealth worth 210 crore rupees. Sahu claimed a related audio clip was fake, while the Congress demanded an unbiased investigation.

item.title: Kenya Ebola Infections Reach Eight as Outbreak Widens in Congo
item.description: Health authorities in Kenya reported a total of eight Ebola cases within the nation. Simultaneously, the virus has reached an eighth province in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

item.title: Alberta Military Base Fire Leaves 39 Hospitalized and Four Dead
item.description: Thirty-nine individuals required hospital treatment after a blaze at a Canadian military facility in Alberta, with a minimum of 19 in critical condition. Prime Minister Mark Carney previously verified the deaths of four military personnel.

item.title: Blaze at Canadian Military Facility Results in Four Fatalities
item.description: A Saturday fire during training exercises at an Alberta military installation caused four military deaths and hospitalized 39 individuals. Premier Danielle Smith reported on Sunday that at least 19 of the injured remain in critical condition.

item.title: Omar Abdullah demands response to Haryana bus assault
item.description: Politician Omar Abdullah has urged authorities to take swift action following an assault on a bus traveling to Jammu and Kashmir through Haryana.

item.title: FWICE demands protection for Tiger Shroff after shooting incident
item.description: On Sunday, the Federation of Western India Cine Employees condemned gunfire directed at Tiger Shroff's vehicle, demanding enhanced protection for the actor and his household.

item.title: Chicago confronts new wave of synthetic drugs
item.description: Journalist Quentin Sommerville reports from Chicago on local efforts to counter an influx of synthetic narcotics affecting American neighborhoods.

item.title: Macron denounces unrest after riots result in arrests
item.description: French leader Emmanuel Macron stated that demonstrators who targeted official facilities must face legal consequences for their unlawful actions following widespread looting and detentions.

item.title: Manasi and Thulasimathi advance to para-badminton semifinals
item.description: Indian para-badminton players Manasi and Thulasimathi progressed to the semifinal stage of their tournament. Because losing semifinalists secure bronze, this advancement guarantees India a podium finish.

item.title: Missouri fence dispute leads to felony charges and arrest
item.description: Paula Kohensky was jailed on a $500,000 bond after a property line disagreement in St. Charles County escalated into gunfire over fence repairs.

item.title: Amruta claims silver medal at Under-23 World Wrestling Championships
item.description: Amruta secured a silver after dropping the final match to Zablotska, who secured a pin while leading 6-0. This finish brings the Indian women's team total to two medals at the global competition.

item.title: Trump defends easing Russian sanctions and criticizes Zelensky
item.description: US President Donald Trump asserted on Sunday that Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelensky is stalling conflict resolution and lacks commitment to peace. Trump maintained that talks to conclude the four-year war are advancing well despite his criticisms.

item.title: যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে ডোনাল্ড ট্রাম্পের বিরুদ্ধে দেশব্যাপী বিক্ষোভ
item.description: ওয়াশিংটন ও নিউইয়র্কসহ মার্কিন বিভিন্ন শহরে ট্রাম্পের বিরুদ্ধে প্রায় তিন হাজার কর্মসূচি পালিত হয়েছে। এসব সমাবেশে নাগরিকরা ট্রাম্পের নীতির প্রতি ক্ষোভ প্রকাশ করেন।

item.title: France urges Israel to prosecute attackers of visiting mayor
item.description: Paris called on Israeli officials to apprehend and prosecute perpetrators of violent acts against a visiting mayor. The French government emphasized that international law requires authorities to protect civilians and halt criminal aggression.

item.title: Benchmark Partners Discuss Venture Capital Strategy in San Francisco
item.description: Five venture partners from the historic firm Benchmark discussed their ongoing investment approach while remaining based in San Francisco. The panel reflected on maintaining their established investment philosophy amidst a competitive market.

item.title: Indian Athletes Participate in Para Asian Games Opening
item.description: Over 100 Indian competitors joined the opening ceremony of the Para Asian Games. Paralympic medalist Simran Sharma and badminton player Pramod Bhagat served as flag bearers, leading the national contingent during the march.

item.title: Family Shares Tributes Following the Passing of Presley Gerber
item.description: Cindy Crawford, Rande Gerber, and their daughter Kaia posted emotional social media tributes after Presley Gerber passed away. The family members expressed their profound sorrow and shared memories of him.

item.title: Pakistani Officials Report Casualties Among Afghan Taliban Forces
item.description: Security officials in Pakistan stated that several Afghan Taliban personnel died in border clashes. The exchange occurred in Upper Kurram and Ghuz Garhi after Afghan forces allegedly fired to aid militant infiltration.

item.title: Macron Appeals for Restraint Following French Riots
item.description: Following widespread unrest and ongoing looting in the capital, French leader Emmanuel Macron addressed the nation to urge stability and peace.

item.title: Pakistan Defeats Sri Lanka in Tri-Series Opener
item.description: Pakistan defeated Sri Lanka in their tri-series opener after posting a total of 305 runs in 49.5 overs. Salman Agha contributed a century, scoring 107 runs from 90 deliveries following Sri Lanka's decision to field first.

item.title: Anthropic Pledges 5 Percent of Shares to Public Fund
item.description: Artificial intelligence firm Anthropic has announced that it will allocate five percent of its equity into a dedicated public benefit trust.

item.title: Union Minister Discusses NCR Pollution with Start-up Founders
item.description: A Union Minister held a meeting with various start-up leaders to discuss air pollution issues in the National Capital Region. The talks focused on potential technological solutions and collaborative efforts.

item.title: Inspections Reveal Expired Items and Pests at Delhi Delivery Hubs
item.description: Authorities discovered expired goods and pest infestations during inspections of online food delivery warehouses in Delhi. The findings raised safety concerns regarding food storage practices at these facilities.

item.title: ইউরোপজুড়ে জীবনযাত্রার ব্যয় ও আবাসন নিয়ে বিক্ষোভ
item.description: ফ্রান্স, স্পেন ও আলবেনিয়ার পর এবার পর্তুগাল ও ইতালিতেও আন্দোলন শুরু হয়েছে। উচ্চ জীবনযাত্রার ব্যয় এবং আবাসনসংকটই এসব বিক্ষোভের মূল কারণ।

item.title: Tirana Supreme Court Building Burns Amid Ongoing Unrest
item.description: As anti-government demonstrations reached their fifth consecutive day, the Supreme Court facilities in Albania's capital caught fire.

item.title: Jamia Students Face Disciplinary Action After Hunger Strike
item.description: Students at Jamia who participated in a hunger strike were forcibly removed from the area. They subsequently faced disciplinary measures, including rustication and a ban from entering the campus.

item.title: Kochi water distribution disrupted due to new KWA tanker fees
item.description: Water delivery services in Kochi are facing disruptions after the Kerala Water Authority introduced a new administrative fee. This extra charge comes on top of existing water costs, straining suppliers financially.
